content.title: Justin Bieber Performs Songs from Every Era of His Career as He Headlines Coachella 2026 with Surprise Guests
content.text: NEED TO KNOW Justin Bieber performed a slew of hits off his albums SWAG and SWAG II as he headlined Coachella in Indio, Calif., on Saturday, April 11The "Yukon" singer was joined during his set by special guests, including Wizkid, Tems and The Kid LAROI Bieber headlines alongside Sabrina Carpenter and Karol G at this year's three-day music and arts festival Justin Bieber is giving the internet another reason to go viral! The Canadian superstar, 32, was met by a massive crowd as he performed his headlining set on the second night of Coachella on Saturday, April 11. He appeared relaxed as he arrived on the stage in a hoodie, shorts and sunglasses. "Tell me what song you guys want to hear tonight," said Bieber, interacting with the crowd and viewers on the festival's live stream. He then ripped through a number of songs off his two latest releases, SWAG and SWAG II, performing them for the first time in front of a live audience. Justin Bieber singing alongside a throwback video at Coachella. Coachella/Youtube During the set, he used a laptop to pull up highly-streamed videos of himself, including old YouTube clips of him singing covers and the "standing on business" confrontation with a paparazzi that went viral last June. The "Yukon" singer included songs from his early career, such as "Baby" and "Beauty and a Beat" in his headline set. He also surprised Coachella attendees with appearances from Wizkid, Tems, the Kid LAROI, Dijon and Mk.gee. His wife, Hailey, 29, was in the crowd to support him. While performing “Everything Hallelujah,” the singer shouted out Hailey and their 19-month-old son, Jack Blues. A now-viral clip shared on X shows Hailey waving in response to the sweet moment. Justin Bieber performs onstage at the 68th Grammy Awards. Christopher Polk/Billboard via Getty In February, Bieber debuted "Yukon" live at the Grammys, where he wore nothing but satin boxers and socks for the acoustic performance in front of a packed Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles. The shorts were custom-made by his new fashion brand, SKYLRK. As a result of the camera angles, Bieber's backside was in focus for eagle-eyed Bieber fans (ahem, Beliebers) who believe the black ink in the upper-mid portion of his back is an outline of his model wife's face from her March 2020 Elle cover. Related Stories Ahead of the festival, Bieber has been giving his fans a sneak preview at his upcoming shows on Twitch by sharing videos of himself and his crew putting together his Coachella set. "Justin's Twitch is his way of letting fans see that he's excited and working hard for his headlining set at Coachella," a source close to the artist told PEOPLE in October. Justin Bieber and Hailey Bieber at the 2026 Grammy Awards. Gilbert Flores/Billboard via Getty The Biebers attended Coachella last year and threw a private party with an A-list guest list inside the newly introduced Red Bull Mirage located near the Quasar Stage. The event took place simultaneously with the festival happenings, a source told PEOPLE at the time. The intimate party began around midnight, the same time Coachella headliner Lady Gaga wowed the crowd with her two-hour setlist of hits and onstage theatrics at the festival's Main Stage. Mustard, too, performed at overlapping hours over at the Sahara Stage. Hailey hosted the A-list guests in attendance, while Justin arrived at approximately 1:30 a.m. PT, the insider shared. Attendees included friends of the Biebers, along with notable Hollywood names.
